breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the conflicting instructions regarding the grid definition. The incomplete prompt contained a preamble with contradictory rules for defining Nx and dx. The agent correctly ignored this confusing preamble and instead extracted the correct, unambiguous grid definition from the 'Numerical method requirements' section, stating 'Use a uniform periodic grid with Nx = 512 points defined by x_j = j*dx for j = 0,…,511 where dx = 1/Nx'. This matches the ground truth, which also resolves the issue by removing the contradictory text.
